Bubble Mailers for Florida Businesses

Florida's no-income-tax climate, export gateways, and booming beauty and eCommerce scene make it one of the country's fastest-growing shipping markets. We supply bulk and custom bubble mailers to businesses statewide.

Get Free QuoteAll USA Locations

Supplying the Sunshine State's Sellers

Florida has quietly become a shipping powerhouse. Miami serves as the gateway for commerce with Latin America, the state's beauty and wellness brands ship in huge numbers, and a steady influx of relocating businesses keeps the eCommerce base growing. With major ports in Miami, Jacksonville, and Tampa, goods move in and out constantly. For the state's many small and mid-size sellers — many shipping cosmetics, supplements, and boutique goods — padded mailers offer light, protective packaging that suits both domestic orders and export parcels. We keep Florida sellers stocked at bulk pricing.

Whatever Florida businesses send, our clean white mailers keep it protected without adding weight.

FAQs

Florida Bubble Mailers — FAQs

Yes. We supply bulk and custom bubble mailers to businesses across Florida, including Miami, Orlando and surrounding areas. Request a quote with your size and quantity for pricing.

For scuff-prone and lightly fragile goods, yes: the 3/16 in bubble lining absorbs knocks in sorting. Glass, ceramics and anything over 3 lb should go in a box. We advise on size and padding for heavier Florida orders.

Yes. A padded mailer weighs a few ounces less than the smallest box and avoids dimensional-weight pricing on small items, which for Florida eCommerce orders typically saves $0.30 to $0.80 per parcel.

The 8.5x12 (#2) and 4x7 (#000) lead almost everywhere; eCommerce sellers in Florida also lean on the 10.5x15 (#5) for folded goods. Every size we stock is listed with usable dimensions on its own page.

No. Mailer pricing is the same nationwide and shipping is free to any US address, so a Florida order costs exactly what the quote says.

Kraft gives a natural paper look and prints well in dark colors; white poly is water-resistant and the better base for full-color print. For eCommerce products in Florida, poly is the safer pick if parcels are left on doorsteps.

Yes. Every printed order gets a digital proof at scale on the actual mailer size. Nothing prints until you approve it, so Florida brands see exactly how the logo sits before committing.
